-- Path: ReplicatedStorage.Framework.Features.Inventory.Kinds.Unit.UnitSelectController
-- ClassName: ModuleScript
-- Source:

local v1 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local v_u_2 = require(v1.Framework.Features.Data.DataController)
local v_u_3 = require(v1.Framework.Features.Inventory.EntryIcon)
local v_u_4 = require(v1.Framework.Features.Inventory.EntryRegistry)
local v_u_5 = require(v1.Framework.Features.UI.MenuController)
local v6 = require(v1.Framework.Features.UI.UIReferences)
local v_u_7 = require(v1.Packages.Maid)
local v_u_8 = v6.Menus.SelectUnit
local v9 = {}
local v_u_10 = {}
local function v_u_16() -- name: updateMenu
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_8
	for v11, v12 in pairs(v_u_10) do
		if not v_u_2.Inventory[v11]() then
			v12:Destroy()
			v_u_10[v11] = nil
		end
		if not v12 or (v12.destroyed or not v12.icon.Parent) then
			v_u_10[v11] = nil
		end
	end
	for v13, v14 in pairs(v_u_2.Inventory()) do
		if v_u_4.getEntryConfig(v14.name).kind == "Unit" and not v_u_10[v13] then
			local v15 = v_u_3.new({
				["key"] = nil,
				["tooltip"] = true,
				["key"] = v13
			})
			v_u_10[v13] = v15
			v15.icon.Parent = v_u_8.Content.ScrollingFrame
		end
	end
end
local v_u_17 = nil
function v9.OpenSelectMenu(p_u_18, p19) -- name: OpenSelectMenu
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_10
	if v_u_17 then
		v_u_17:Destroy()
		v_u_17 = nil
	end
	v_u_16()
	v_u_5.OpenMenu(v_u_8)
	v_u_17 = v_u_7.new()
	for _, v_u_20 in pairs(v_u_10) do
		if p19 then
			p19(v_u_20)
		end
		v_u_17:Add(v_u_20.icon.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (copy) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_17
			p_u_18(v_u_20)
			v_u_17:Destroy()
		end))
	end
	v_u_17:Add(v_u_5.Closed:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_17
		if v_u_17 then
			v_u_17:Destroy()
		end
	end))
end
return v9

function v4.RollUnit(p6) -- name: RollUnit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_5
	local v7 = 0
	local v8 = {}
	for v9, v10 in pairs(v_u_2.entriesOfKind("Unit")) do
		if v10.chance then
			local v11
			for v12, v13 in pairs(v_u_3) do
				local v14 = v10.chance() * v13.chance / (p6 or 1)
				if v14 >= 1 then
					local v15 = 1 / v14
					v11 = v7 + v15
					table.insert(v8, {
						["unit"] = v9,
						["chance"] = v15,
						["mutation"] = v12
					})
					v7 = v11
				end
			end
			local v16 = v10.chance() / (p6 or 1)
			if v16 >= 1 then
				local v17 = 1 / v16
				v11 = v7 + v17
				table.insert(v8, {
					["unit"] = nil,
					["chance"] = nil,
					["mutation"] = nil,
					["unit"] = v9,
					["chance"] = v17
				})
				v7 = v11
			end
		end
	end
	local v18 = v_u_5:NextNumber(0, v7)
	local v19 = 0
	local v20 = nil
	local v21 = nil
	for _, v22 in pairs(v8) do
		v19 = v19 + v22.chance
		if v18 <= v19 then
			v20 = v22.unit
			v21 = v22.mutation
			break
		end
	end
	return v20, v21
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_156
	local v157 = v_u_3.LocalPlayer.Character

		if v158 then
			for _, v159 in workspace.Plots.Claimed:GetChildren() do
				local v160 = v159.Slots
				local v161 = v159:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
				if v161 then

					if (v161.Position - v158.Position).Magnitude >= 230 then

							v163.Parent = v162
						end

							v164.Parent = v160

function v_u_11.completeFloor(p31) -- name: completeFloor
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_18
	local v32 = p31.towerConfig.enemyHealth(p31.floor)
	local v33 = p31.towerConfig.enemyDamage(p31.floor)
	local v34 = {}
	while #p31.team > 0 do
		local v35 = p31.team[p31.currentTeamMember]
		if not v35 then
			p31:Destroy()
			break
		end
		if p31.endingQueued then
			local v36 = {
				["action"] = v_u_3.Actions.ended,
				["rewards"] = p31.rewards
			}
			table.insert(v34, v36)
			p31:Destroy()
			break
		end
		local v37 = {
			["action"] = v_u_3.Actions.floorStarted,
			["teamMember"] = p31.currentTeamMember,
			["teamMemberHealth"] = v35.health,
			["enemyHealth"] = v32,
			["floor"] = p31.floor
		}
		table.insert(v34, v37)
		v32 = v32 - v35.damage
		local v38 = {
			["action"] = v_u_3.Actions.damageEnemy,
			["amount"] = v35.damage,
			["enemyHealth"] = v32
		}
		table.insert(v34, v38)
		if v32 <= 0 then
			local v39 = p31.floor
			p31.floor = p31.floor + 1
			local v40 = {}
			for _, v41 in pairs(p31.towerConfig.drops) do
				if v41.minFloor <= v39 then
					for _, v42 in pairs(v41.entries) do
						if v_u_10:NextNumber() * 100 <= v42.chance then
							p31.rewards[v42.name] = (p31.rewards[v42.name] or 0) + v42.amount
							v40[v42.name] = (v40[v42.name] or 0) + v42.amount
						end
					end
				end
			end
			for v43, v44 in pairs(v40) do
				v_u_6.Give(p31.player, v43, v44)
			end
			local v45 = {
				["action"] = v_u_3.Actions.floorCompleted,
				["floor"] = v39,
				["rewards"] = v40
			}
			table.insert(v34, v45)
			if p31.towerConfig.maxFloors and p31.floor > p31.towerConfig.maxFloors then
				v_u_9.AddProgress(p31.player, "Towers", 1)
				local v46 = {
					["action"] = v_u_3.Actions.ended,
					["rewards"] = p31.rewards
				}
				table.insert(v34, v46)
				p31:Destroy()
			end
			break
		end
		v35.health = v35.health - v33
		local v47 = {
			["action"] = v_u_3.Actions.damagePlayer,
			["amount"] = v33,
			["teamMemberHealth"] = v35.health
		}
		table.insert(v34, v47)
		if v35.health <= 0 then
			local v48 = {
				["action"] = v_u_3.Actions.memberDefeated,
				["teamMember"] = p31.currentTeamMember
			}
			table.insert(v34, v48)
			p31.currentTeamMember = p31.currentTeamMember + 1
		end
		if p31.currentTeamMember > #p31.team then
			local v49 = {
				["action"] = v_u_3.Actions.ended,
				["rewards"] = p31.rewards
			}
			table.insert(v34, v49)
			p31:Destroy()
			break
		end
	end
	return v34, v_u_18(v34)
end

function v_u_9.ChangeOffer(p67, p68, p69, p70) -- name: ChangeOffer
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_7
	if p67.destroyed or p67.phase == "Countdown" then
		return
	elseif typeof(p70) == "number" and (p70 == p70 and (math.abs(p70) ~= (1 / 0) and (p70 % 1 == 0 and p70 ~= 0))) then
		local v71 = v_u_4[p68].Inventory[p69]()
		if v71 then
			if p70 > 0 and table.find(v_u_3.UNTRADEABLE_ENTRIES, v71.name) then
				local v72 = {
					["message"] = nil,
					["notificationType"] = "error",
					["message"] = v71.name .. " cannot be traded."
				}
				v_u_7.SendTextNotification(p68, v72)
				return
			else
				local v73 = p67.offers[p68][p69] or 0
				if p70 > 0 and v73 == 0 then
					local v74 = 0
					for _ in p67.offers[p68] do
						v74 = v74 + 1
					end
					if v_u_3.MAX_UNIQUE_ENTRIES <= v74 then
						local v75 = {
							["message"] = nil,
							["notificationType"] = "error",
							["message"] = ("You can\'t offer more than %* unique entries."):format(v_u_3.MAX_UNIQUE_ENTRIES)
						}
						v_u_7.SendTextNotification(p68, v75)
						return
					end
				end
				local v76 = v73 + p70
				local v77 = v71.amount
				local v78 = math.clamp(v76, 0, v77)
				if v78 ~= v73 then
					local v79 = p67.offers[p68]
					if v78 <= 0 then
						v78 = nil
					end
					v79[p69] = v78
					p67:ResetConfirmation()
					p67:Broadcast()
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
function v_u_9.Advance(p80, p81) -- name: Advance
	if p80.destroyed or p80.phase == "Countdown" then
		return
	elseif p80:SanitizeOffers() then
		local v82 = p80:GetOtherPlayer(p81)
		if p80.phase == "Offer" then
			p80.ready[p81] = not p80.ready[p81]
			if p80.ready[p81] and p80.ready[v82] then
				p80.phase = "Confirm"
				p80.accepted[p81] = false
				p80.accepted[v82] = false
			end

			v18.Parent = v19
		end
	end
}
